Theme: <name>

- [ ] Only `dev/themes/submissions/<slug>/` changed (not `docs/home/themes.json`)
- [ ] `theme.tvtheme.json` exported from the app, with `"by"`
- [ ] `preview.jpg` is a TV screenshot, 1280x720, at most 150 KB
- [ ] `wall.jpg` (if any) is my own photo, at most 1 MB
- [ ] No web addresses in the settings, no faces of other people, nudity, violence, logos or ads
